title: Occupational Therapist
canonicalBaseline: Career Profiles full snapshot: Not started. Re-read Article Sections, Sources and Media before applying.
intro: Occupational therapists (OTs) help people participate in meaningful everyday activities. Here, “occupation” includes self-care, school, play, family responsibilities, work, and leisure—not only paid employment. Illness, injury, disability, or developmental needs can make these activities difficult.
